author.bio_short: Justin Borges is a Pasadena-based real estate agent with 13+ years of experience and over $200M in career sales. He specializes in probate and inherited property, Proposition 19 transfers, rent-controlled property sales, and architectural homes throughout Pasadena, Altadena, and the greater San Gabriel Valley.
author.bio_long: Justin Borges founded The Borges Real Estate Team at eXp Realty after more than a decade helping Los Angeles County residents navigate complex real estate situations. With over $200M in career sales and a 106% average list-to-sale ratio, Justin has built his practice around the cases most agents avoid: probate sales, inherited property, rent-controlled buildings, fire recovery, and the architectural homes that define communities like Pasadena and Altadena. He holds DRE license #01940318 and serves Pasadena, Altadena, Greater LA, and the San Gabriel Valley.
